pages.title: Weights: data/weighing_types
pages.text: Defines each fish's weight distribution in $(bold)jin$() (0.5 kg).$(br2)$(br){"name": "Freshwater Fish",$(br)"weights": {$(br)  "flavor_immersed_daily_argo:raw_grass_carp":$(br)    {"mean": 6.0, "sigma": 2.0, "min": 1.5, "max": 20.0}$(br)}}$(br2)$(thing)mean$() is the average, $(thing)sigma$() the standard deviation (defaults to 25% of the mean); the result is clamped to $(thing)min$()~$(thing)max$().$(br2)This list has a second job: anything here automatically joins the buy-by-jin market and settles at the per-jin price from $(thing)weight_price$(). Items missing from the registry (mod not installed) are skipped silently, so external fish are safe to list - the mod ships $(thing)freshwater_fish.json$() plus $(thing)aquaculture_fish$(), $(thing)starcatcher_fish$() and $(thing)tide_fish$().

pages.title: Codex: data/fishing_handbook
pages.text: One file per fish. Fields:$(br)$(li)$(thing)item$(): the caught item$(br)$(li)$(thing)entity$(): optional entity id$(br)$(li)$(thing)name$(), $(thing)description$(): display text$(br)$(li)$(thing)habitat$(): $(thing)fresh$() / $(thing)ocean$() / $(thing)both$()$(br)$(li)$(thing)diet$(): $(thing)omnivore$() / $(thing)herbivore$() / $(thing)carnivore$()

pages.title: Codex (continued)
pages.text: $(li)$(thing)activity$(): string array such as $(thing)["day"]$() or $(thing)["night","rain"]$()$(br)$(li)$(thing)alertness$(): $(thing)low$() / $(thing)medium$() / $(thing)high$()$(br)$(li)$(thing)feeding_speed$(): same three levels, drives the bite window$(br)$(li)$(thing)struggle_tension$(): struggle tension, default 8$(br)$(li)$(thing)biomes$() and $(thing)depth$(): optional display info$(br)$(li)$(thing)order$(): codex sort order, default 0

pages.title: Crabber's Delight entries
pages.text: The mod ships four $(thing)crabbersdelight_*.json$() codex files for crab $(thing:crabbersdelight:crab$()), shrimp $(thing:crabbersdelight:shrimp$()), clawster $(thing:crabbersdelight:clawster$()) and clam $(thing:crabbersdelight:clam$()). All four are ocean omnivores, fishable at any depth and all day, with the default struggle tension of 8.$(br2)They differ only in alertness and feeding speed: crab low/slow, shrimp low/fast, clawster medium/slow, clam low/slow.$(br2)These items come from an optional mod; without it the entries are skipped silently and neither the catch pool nor the market shows them. Reload the datapack after editing a codex file.

pages.title: JEI catch category
pages.text: $(bold)Catch Codex$() is a separate $(thing)JEI$() category using the Nanshan rod ($(thing)nameless_rod$()) as its catalyst. Open any catch and the right panel shows its hook conditions: habitat, diet, active time, alertness, feeding speed and struggle tension.$(br2)Pages are built from the server-synced $(thing)data/fishing_handbook$() and refresh on login and datapack reload. Leaving a world clears the client snapshot and JEI entries so the previous session's fish do not leak into the next one.$(br2)Entity-only entries without an item icon stay out of item pages but still appear in the in-game handbook; missing JEI or Crabber's Delight never prevents startup.

pages.title: Tackle: data/fishing_rod_parts
pages.text: The six slots are line, rod, reel, bait, float and sinker; the slot decides which stats are read. Undefined stats count as 0 and affect nothing.$(br2)Available fields: $(thing)durability$(), $(thing)hardness$(), $(thing)tension$(), $(thing)stretch$(), $(thing)thickness$(), $(thing)drag$(), $(thing)reel_speed$(), $(thing)weight$(), $(thing)anti_current$(), $(thing)size$(), $(thing)set_depth$().$(br2)Example: $(thing){"item": "...:rod_bamboo", "durability": 80, "tension": 12, "hardness": 1}$()
